detail: Demoted: the native core removed most of the need. An index sweep is 1.7 s and a spread analysis 0.5 s, so this is a convenience now rather than a fix. Worth doing when a screen starts re-solving on every keystroke.
doneWhen: Solves keyed on the rules slug, the composition hash and the engine version, stored under `data/cache/`, invalidated on an engine version change and never on a timestamp.
title: Result cache with provenance
